name: Renlei Bug Qingchu Jihua
source:
If love is an error you can’t fix… will you delete me—or choose to keep me? Step into the role of a censor and dive into a story of order, freedom, and love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515540/Error_Love__Human_Bug_Eradication_Project/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如果爱是一个你无法修复的错误……你会删除我——还是选择保留我？扮演审查员的角色，深入了解秩序、自由和爱的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515540/Error_Love__Human_Bug_Eradication_Project/]Steam[/url]]
